Title: Suresh and the Family

Cast

1. Suresh - 32 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Pallavi - 26 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Karan - 36 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Sunita - 34 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Suresh stands in the mall. Karan and Sunita stand near him.]

Karan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Suresh tries on a new jacket.]

Suresh (happily): "Sunita, listen!"

[Suresh pays at the counter.]

Suresh: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Suresh carries the shopping bags out.]

Sunita: "What a day to remember!"
